hero.lead: Get the smile of your dreams in just 3 visits. Safe procedures, zero pain, and a team of expert doctors dedicated to changing lives.
hero.promise: You approve your new smile before we ever touch a tooth.

problems.q: I’ve hidden my smile for years.
problems.a: A smile design is planned around your face, not just your teeth. Most patients tell us the first thing that changes is how often they smile in photos.
Our veneers are as thin as 0.3 mm, so most cases need little to no drilling. Your natural tooth stays almost entirely intact.

problems.q: I’m afraid it will look fake.
problems.a: You approve a preview of the design in your own mouth before any permanent work starts. Shade, length and shape are adjusted with you, not for you.

problems.q: I can’t take months off for appointments.
problems.link: Done in one week in Miami
problems.a: Everything before your trip happens from home. In Miami it takes three visits across one week: exam, preparation, delivery.

problems.q: I was quoted more than $15,000 somewhere else.
problems.link: What it costs here, in writing
problems.a: Full smile designs here start well below that, and you get the number in writing before you book anything. No surprise add-ons at the chair.

problems.q: I don’t know who to trust with my face.
problems.link: Meet the doctors and see real cases
problems.a: Every case on this site is a real patient treated by the doctors you will meet. Look at the before and after photos and judge the work yourself.

problems.q: My teeth are stained and whitening does nothing.
problems.a: Tetracycline, fluorosis and deep internal discoloration do not lift with whitening. Porcelain veneers cover the stain with a shade matched in person, in daylight, and you approve the design before any tooth is prepared.

problems.q: I have gaps and chipped edges, not just color.
problems.link: Gaps and chips closed in one week
problems.a: Gaps are closed and chipped or worn edges are rebuilt in the same design, in one week, without years of aligners. Shape, length and shade are planned together around your face.

problems.q: I live out of state. How would this even work?
problems.a: Photos, estimate, payment plan and dates all happen from home. In Miami it is three visits in one week, with a hotel shortlist, airport pickup and rides to every visit handled by your coordinator.

directions.title: From the airport
directions.body: About 15 minutes by car. Take SR-836 West to 87th Ave, then south to SW 8th St. Rideshare pickup is at MIA arrivals level.

directions.title: Parking
directions.body: Free parking on site. The entrance is on SW 8th St (Calle Ocho); take the stairs or elevator to the 2nd floor.

directions.title: Public transit
directions.body: Metrobus Route 8 stops at SW 8th St and 84th Ave, a 2-minute walk. Tamiami Station is the nearest Metrorail connection.

directions.title: Hours
directions.body: Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm. Out-of-state patients can request early or consecutive-day appointments.
